skill_isolation.limitation_note: Skills are staged into the self-contained plugin tree; skill-level isolation relies on repository and workspace boundaries since Claude Code loads all plugin skills into the active session context.

forks.omission_note: Session forks are an interactive terminal feature not supported or exposed in headless (`claude -p`) evaluation; parallel exploration must be orchestrated externally via isolated workspaces.

subagents.note: Custom subagents are defined as Markdown manifests under agents/ and dispatched via Claude Code's agent invocation mechanism.

worktrees.limitation_note: Git worktree switching within a single session is not supported natively; Workcell uses external jj workspaces (workcell-ws) to isolate parallel agent worktrees.

workflow_surfaces.omission_note: Interactive Workflow UI surfaces are omitted in headless mode; execution adheres strictly to CLI command line, prompt input, and JSON handoff schemas.

command_hooks.note: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, and SubagentStop command hooks are supported natively via hooks/hooks.json and invoke shared guards.
